title: Beaten
description:
Beaten is a short film that follows the theme of faith and specifically addresses the subject of faith in oneself. The short film was produced under constraints that must be respected:
Have at least one 3D character with a full rig in a background that can be 3D or 2D.
The short film must have a maximum duration of 5 minutes.

Synopsis:
Oliver Todd or as the characters call him Slugger, is an underground boxer who was given the opportunity to enter the professional world of a galactic arena but at the cost of losing his entire planet if he loses. Being placed in a high risk, high reward situation, Slugger was hesitant but if he wanted to change his life forever, he had to take on this difficult challenge.
